bio_en: Barunak Kaputikian, pen-name Hur, was born in 1888 into a modest family in the Ararq quarter of Aygestan in Van. Against his father's wishes he studied at the parish school and from 1903 at the new Haykazian central school, reading revolutionary literature at night; through his brother he came into contact with Vardges, Koms, Aram, Ishkhan and other revolutionaries in Van, and by 1904-05 he was a committed Dashnak. From September 1907, at Aram's suggestion, he wrote for Hairenik, Sipan and other papers. He reached Tiflis with the refugees from Van on 18 October 1915 and died in Yerevan in 1918.
